⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧{退職|たいしょく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦あと→あと：09580_ato⟧5⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I have 5 more years until mandatory retirement.

notes:
{退職|たいしょく} means leaving one's job, whether by resignation or retirement.

Common types:
- ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧{退職|たいしょく} (mandatory retirement)
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧{退職|たいしょく} (voluntary resignation)
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧{退職|たいしょく} (company-initiated separation)
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧{退職|たいしょく} (early retirement)

Common expressions:
- ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧ / ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧ (resignation letter)
- ⟦{退職金|たいしょくきん}→退職金：07959_taishokukin⟧ (severance pay, retirement allowance)
- {退職|たいしょく}⟦{代行|だいこう}→代行：11433_daikou⟧ (resignation proxy service)

Note: ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧ is a formal notification, while ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧ is a request that can be withdrawn.
